\[

\]

\[

\lim_{h\to 0^+}\frac{|h|-0}{h}=1

\[

\]

Since the one-sided derivatives are different, \(f'(0)\) does not exist. Thus, \(f(x)=|x|\) is continuous but not differentiable at \(x=0\).
